title: Crazy Legs Mundell Rampage map source (clmr-map version 2)
description: godot/maps/<id>.map.json. 1 map unit = 1 cell; x east, y south, z up; eye .95, door 1.85, step .245, body .2 round, 1.12 tall. From tools/map.gd -- schema.

base.description: build on tools/levels/<plan>_plan.gd; then size/districts come from it

border.description: the tile of the solid cells round everything

meta.description: title, sky, score, ambience, intro, heading, layout (bump layout when the map changes: old saves start the chapter over)

rect.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] map units, x1 y1 exclusive

mood.description: version 2: the whole map's mood (fog, grade, sounds); districts may have their own

modes.description: version 2: the modes the map is made for; map check reviews each

seed.description: version 2: the looks dice (the map id's hash when left out)

prefabs.description: version 2: groups of objects placed by prefab objects (also maps/prefabs/<name>.json)

oneOf.title: ramp
oneOf.description: A slope from z `from` up to `to` toward n/e/s/w (solid to the ground unless `thick`). `walk` false: a face too steep to stand on (up to 4 in 1).

oneOf.title: stairs
oneOf.description: Stairs from `from` up to `to` toward n/e/s/w, treads `rise` high at most.

oneOf.title: wall
oneOf.description: A free wall a to b; `openings` [{id, at, width, sill, head}] cut doors and windows. `z1b` (0 or more): its top at b, sloping from `z1` at a (a gable; no openings).

curve.description: the wall bent round centre: from and to in degrees (0 east, 90 south)

oneOf.title: rail
oneOf.description: A rail standing on z: stops bodies, not looks or shots.

oneOf.title: cover
oneOf.description: Low solid cover a to b: stops bodies, looks and shots under its top.

oneOf.title: balcony
oneOf.description: A deck railed on the `open` sides (n, e, s, w); `gaps` [[side, from, to]].

rect.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] map units, x1 y1 exclusive

oneOf.title: bridge
oneOf.description: A deck across a gap at `top`, railed along its long sides; walk under it.

oneOf.title: ceiling

oneOf.title: room_poly
oneOf.description: A room of any outline, a wall on each edge; `openings` [[edge, {at, width}]].

oneOf.title: corridor
oneOf.description: A roofed passage `width` cells wide along a path of cell centres (straight legs, n/s/e/w).

oneOf.title: fixture
oneOf.description: A box of furniture (a counter, a crate stack): stops bodies; not walked on.

rect.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] map units, x1 y1 exclusive

oneOf.title: prop
oneOf.description: A modelled prop (town_props.json names) standing at `at`.

oneOf.title: sign
oneOf.description: A flat picture standing at `at` (a sign, a board).

oneOf.title: enemy
oneOf.description: A hand of `kind` (enemies.cfg) standing at `at`, on the floor at or under z.

oneOf.title: pickup
oneOf.description: A pickup lying at `at`.

oneOf.title: station
oneOf.description: An objective: a quest station used at `at`; `opens` door cells; `prop` a town_quest_<name>.

oneOf.title: exit
oneOf.description: The level's exit (extraction) at `at`, open once `shutdown` is done.

oneOf.title: spawn_point
oneOf.description: A named place a player or bot can start a playtest from (and a versus spawn).

oneOf.title: label
oneOf.description: A name on the automap.

oneOf.title: allow_overlap
oneOf.description: Says two or more objects overlap on purpose (validate stops calling it an error).

oneOf.title: kit
oneOf.description: Any kit piece by name (piece): needed for stairs, ramp, fence, bridge and wall, whose names are v1 types. Takes the piece's own keys.

oneOf.title: terrain
oneOf.description: Ground shaped over rect: brush hill (a round rise `height` high), ditch (a trench along the long side), plateau (flat top, `falloff` cells of slope), ramp (up toward n/e/s/w), flat (set to height), smooth, noise (seeded bumps up to height), heights ((w+1)*(h+1) corner heights). Brushes add up; steeper than 1 in 1 is a cliff.

rect.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] map units, x1 y1 exclusive

oneOf.title: road
oneOf.description: A road along points, `width` cells wide: surface blacktop, gravel, dirt, concrete or oil; `shoulder` cells of gravel each side (blacktop 1, others 0); `ditch` a shallow ditch beyond them. Plants keep off it; a creek crossing it gets a bridge.

oneOf.title: creek
oneOf.description: A creek along points, `width` wide, its bed carved `depth` down, a shore round it.

oneOf.title: pond
oneOf.description: A pond: `at` + `radius`, a `rect` or a `polygon`. Flat water, a shore, deep water (nobody wades it) in its middle unless `deep` is false.

rect.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] map units, x1 y1 exclusive

oneOf.title: trough
oneOf.description: A stock trough with water in it: furniture .45 high, `length` .8 to 4 along x or y.

oneOf.title: foliage
oneOf.description: Plants scattered on natural ground in rect or polygon (the whole map when neither): grass, weeds, scrub, tree, pine, cypress, snag, corn (rows), reeds (by water). Never on a road, a route, by a door or a spawn.

rect.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] map units, x1 y1 exclusive

oneOf.title: dress
oneOf.description: `count` hand-made vignettes of a theme set against walls in rect: farm, junk, church, fair, yard_sale, shine, garage, swamp, house, store.

rect.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] map units, x1 y1 exclusive

oneOf.title: vignette
oneOf.description: One vignette by name (dressing.json: porch_sittin, junk_pile, wood_pile...) with its back to the wall on side `wall` (n, e, s, w) of cell `at`.

oneOf.title: set_piece
oneOf.description: A chapter-style big break: kind barn (comes down when its posts are shot), tower (falls and floods), fuel (a fuel line that burns). `falls`: ways it may go.

oneOf.title: switch
oneOf.description: A lever (an objective station): used, it opens the doors named in `opens` (door ids, a kit building's doors too: <id>_door_s); those doors have no handle of their own. `requires`: switches to throw first.

oneOf.title: key
oneOf.description: A key (brass or steel) lying at `at`; the doors named in `doors` need it.

oneOf.title: kill_gate
oneOf.description: When every hand standing in rect is down, the doors in `opens` open (they have no handle till then).

rect.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] map units, x1 y1 exclusive

oneOf.title: wake_zone
oneOf.description: The hands in rect sleep until a player walks into `trigger` (a rect; rect itself when left out), then they all come at once.

trigger.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] map units, x1 y1 exclusive

oneOf.title: message
oneOf.description: Words on the screen when a player walks into rect.

rect.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] map units, x1 y1 exclusive

oneOf.title: trigger
oneOf.description: A level trigger as src/triggers.gd has it (when: area, key, station, kills, after, down; do: message, sound, open, close, lock, wake, alert, light, shake, pickup). open, close and lock may name a door id; area is a rect.

oneOf.title: prefab
oneOf.description: A group of objects defined once (the source's prefabs, or maps/prefabs/<name>.json) placed with its north-west corner at `at`, turned quarter turns clockwise and mirrored. Its objects' ids become <id>_<their id>.

oneOf.title: via
oneOf.description: A nav point by hand: where a way passes that the cells' middles miss.

oneOf.title: dm_spawn
oneOf.description: A deathmatch and team deathmatch start (give 6 or more, spread out). `angle` in degrees; left out, it faces the map's middle.

oneOf.title: team_spawn
oneOf.description: A 5v5 side's start: team attack (the outlaws, who plant or rescue) or defend. `count` places (5) are spread round `at`, facing the other side's start.

oneOf.title: bomb_site
oneOf.description: Search and destroy: bomb site A or B over rect.

oneOf.title: bot_hold
